# Tasks

- [Read each setting from the store in packages/settings](06-settings-package.md) - A new packages/settings holds the list of settings and reads each one with a sqlc query, returning its default when no row exists; auth reads through it; virtual/settings keeps working on top of it until every program has switched.
- [The CMS reads its settings from the store](07-cms-reads-settings.md) - The CMS's settings reads go through packages/settings on each use, cms.New loads and refreshes nothing, and a benchmark of its pages before and after is recorded.
- [Housekeeping and the installer read their settings from the store](08-housekeeping-installer-read-settings.md) - Housekeeping's and the installer's settings reads and writes go through packages/settings, and neither loads settings at start.
- [The game reads settings from the store and checks for waiting updates on use](09-game-reads-settings.md) - The game server reads each setting through packages/settings, loads what it caches the first time no database update waits when a player needs it, refreshes nothing, and virtual/settings and cms.refresh are gone.
- [reborn stops in order](10-reborn-stops-in-order.md) - On Ctrl-C or SIGTERM reborn stops taking requests, logs every player out and closes the game's listeners, stops the scheduled tasks and closes the database, with new Shutdown and Stop functions.
- [reborn-dev and make dev](12-reborn-dev.md) - reborn-dev resolves and proxies every site from the one Astro dev server of the spike, and make dev runs it with air and the dev server.
- [The browser suite reborn](13-browser-suite.md) - A browser suite builds reborn and checks, from an empty folder, the installer, the move to a new port, the hotel after the install, the game's first message, and a stop in order.
- [Releases ship reborn and the four separate programs](14-releases.md) - make release and the release workflow build reborn, cms, housekeeping, installer and server into each archive, and CI runs the reborn suite.
- [The documents say what reborn is](15-documents.md) - The platform feature's later notes, the READMEs and the architecture references describe reborn, the installer under /installer/, settings read from the store, the stop in order and the releases.
- [Check the platform feature's behaviours](16-exit-check.md) - Every behaviour of the platform feature is checked on main and its evidence written in the report, and the feature is closed or what is left is reported.
